title: Cotangent complexes and deformations in ringed topoi
description: Homotopical algebra in a ringed topos and the cohomology of diagrams, as foundations for the cotangent complex of morphisms of ringed topoi: homotopy sheaves and the free abelian Whitehead theorem; derived functors of non-additive functors of complexes, the Deligne-Lazard theorem and the shift formulas; décalage, nerves of internal categories and the homotopy type of a category; strict simplicial objects and Deligne's contractibility theorem; derived colimits; fibred topoi, their total topoi, direct images and modules.
